title: Smart Routing
subtitle: Classify virtual-model requests into simple / complex model groups by sample vector similarity
disabledAlert: Smart routing is disabled; virtual-model requests will not be classified or routed

samples.textExtra: Up to 65,536 characters; the closer the text is to real requests, the more accurate the classification
samples.thresholdExtra: Overrides the global classification threshold; 0 means use the global setting
samples.buildVectorExtra: Requires a vector service configured in Settings; samples without vectors are not matched, and vectors must be rebuilt after changing the embedding model
samples.confirmBuildAll: Vectors for all samples will be rebuilt, which may take a while. Continue?
samples.emptyHint: Add simple / complex samples and build their vectors so smart routing can classify requests.

batch.title: Batch Add Samples
batch.linesExtra: Each line is treated as one sample; blank lines are ignored

preview.title: Preview Decision
preview.placeholder: Enter a request text to see how smart routing would classify it

decisions.emptyHint: Each classification made for a virtual-model request will be recorded here.
